_about: Relationships, English. Copy to <code>.json (de, fr, es, it, pl, ru, cs, ja, zh), translate the values, keep the keys and every {0} and {1}. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
act.alreadyTheCase: Already the case for this playthrough.
action.adoptLegacyStore.confirm: This playthrough claims the main store. If another playthrough owns it, that one will get a store of its own the next time it loads.
action.adoptLegacyStore.help: Reattaches this playthrough to the original store and claims it. Undoes the action above.
action.adoptLegacyStore.label: Return to the main store
action.checkDisplay.confirm: This takes about a minute with 120 bonds, and the game's scripts are busy until it is done.
action.checkDisplay.help: Runs the real IsFollowing, CommitmentState and RomanceApplicability for every bond and compares what the dashboard shows. Slow on purpose: about a minute with 120 bonds. Disagreements go to SkyrimNetRelationships.log.
action.checkDisplay.label: Check the display against the rules
action.enrollActor.help: Starts a bond with the person you were looking at when you opened this, following you or not. Their character is written and their record read over the next few minutes.
action.enrollActor.label: Enroll
action.enrollActor.needs: They were under your crosshair when the dashboard opened.
action.forceDriftReview.help: Reviews one trait now, bypassing both drift gates. A quiet history should come back NO.
action.forceDriftReview.label: Force a drift review
action.reauthorCharacter.confirm: Their character is written again from the record. How they have changed through play since 2.2 is kept; the old one is written to the log, but there is no undo.
action.reauthorCharacter.help: Writes who they are again from the record: orientation, intimacy, ardor, exclusivity, Why and Limit. What they call you is kept.
action.reauthorCharacter.label: Re-author their character
action.requestSparkNow.help: Judges them out of turn instead of waiting for the tenure gate. It does not set a spark; the assessor still decides.
action.requestSparkNow.label: Ask the spark assessor now
action.requestSparkNow.needs: They must be near you, with no spark verdict yet.
action.reseedActor.help: Reads their record again and tops their standing up to what it now supports. It can raise them, never lower them.
action.reseedActor.label: Re-read their standing
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.confirm: Every category where a Relationships block was recorded as taken off gets ours again, if it is empty. Blocks you chose yourself stay. A category you emptied on purpose gets ours back too; take it off again in SeverActions if you meant it.
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.help: For a game where Relationships' bio blocks were deleted in SeverActions and then restored: until 2.1.1 everyone who carried one was recorded as having it taken off, so nobody got it back. Restore the blocks on SeverActions' Bio Blocks page (Hidden) first.
action.restoreOurBioBlocks.label: Give everyone our bio blocks again
action.setCharacterField.help: Writes one trait directly, with no LLM involved. For a single wrong field when the rest are right.
action.setCharacterField.label: Correct one trait
action.startFreshStore.confirm: Everyone in this playthrough starts reading from a new, empty store. The store you leave is untouched, and 'Return to the main store' undoes this.
action.startFreshStore.help: For a new game that inherited another playthrough's characters. Nothing is deleted; the other store stays on disk.
action.startFreshStore.label: Give this playthrough its own store
action.unenrollActor.confirm: They come off the roster and stop being assessed. This is not a reset: what is already stored about them stays.
action.unenrollActor.help: For someone enrolled by mistake. They come off the roster and nothing assesses them from then on.
action.unenrollActor.label: Remove from roster
action.unsparkActor.confirm: Their spark is cleared and the spark tenure gate starts again from now.
action.unsparkActor.help: Clears a spark that should not have happened, keeping every point.
action.unsparkActor.label: Return to the platonic ladder

state.courting.blurb: Said aloud and mutual: they asked, and you said yes.
state.declined.blurb: They asked and you said no. It stings for a while and mends as the bond grows; if they climb back to where they asked, they ask again.
state.devoted.blurb: Said aloud and mutual, and as deep as a bond goes. Whether there has been a wedding is the Commitment line's to say.
state.ended.blurb: It was romantic once, and it is over. There is history between you.
state.foreclosed.blurb: Romance was never a question between you.
state.interested.blurb: Something has crossed on their side, and they have not said it aloud.
state.platonic.blurb: Judged: nothing romantic. The bond climbs freely all the way up.
state.unexamined.blurb: Nobody has judged yet whether anything romantic has crossed. They are held short of Lover until then.
